label: For "Clinical Handoff Quality Assessment": Check whether handoff records contain the structured elements an approved checklist requires and are internally consistent, and give the reviewer a completeness checklist with missing-field flags, contradictions and exact source text. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Letting the model grade quality.
